description: The AKEless Build System for C#/.NET
releaseNotes:
• Removed the Octopus.Nuke.Components package. Its build components now live in this repository's own build
• Removed the net8.0 and net9.0 targets. NUKE now targets net10.0, plus netstandard2.0 or net472 where it did before
• Changed nuke :setup and nuke :update to set the build project's target framework to net10.0
• Changed IHazGitVersion to run GitVersion's net10.0 build, which needs GitVersion.Tool 6.6.0 or later

Full changelog at https://github.com/OctopusDeploy/nuke/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
